kayitlar.b: Szécsénke–Kis-Ferenc-hegy Késő Középső Paleolitikus Ipara és kapcsolatrendszere
kayitlar.y: Krisztián Zandler
kayitlar.w: SZTE Repository of Dissertations (University of Szeged)
kayitlar.o: The dissertation presents a comprehensive archaeological analysis of the Palaeolithic site of Szécsénke–Kis-Ferenc-hegy in the Cserhát Mountains, Northern Hungary. The research focuses on the technological, typological, raw material, spatial and taphonomic characteristics of the lithic assemblages and evaluates the site within the broader context of Central European bifacial and leaf-point industries. The results prove that the surface and near-surface finds represent a technologically and typologically heterogeneous palimpsest, whereas the deeper archaeological horizon excavated between 2015 and 2018 constitutes a substantially more coherent assemblage. Its lithic technology is predominantly flake-oriented and characterised by the intensive use of local limnoquartzite (or, limnic silicite) and by the on-site production, thinning and reshaping of bifacial tools. kayitlar.bt: Szécsénke–Kis-Ferenc Tepesi Geç Orta Paleolitik Dönem Sanatı ve İlişki Ağı
kayitlar.ot: Bu tez çalışması, Kuzey Macaristan'daki Cserhát Dağları'nda yer alan Szécsénke–Kis-Ferenc-hegy Paleolitik yerleşimine ilişkin kapsamlı bir arkeolojik analiz sunmaktadır. Araştırma, taş alet topluluklarının teknolojik, tipolojik, hammadde, mekânsal ve tafonomik özelliklerine odaklanmakta ve alanı Orta Avrupa çift yüzlü ve yaprak biçimli ok ucu endüstrilerinin daha geniş bağlamı içinde değerlendirmektedir. Sonuçlar, yüzey ve yüzeye yakın buluntuların teknolojik ve tipolojik açıdan heterojen bir palimpsest oluşturduğunu, oysa 2015-2018 yılları arasında kazılan daha derin arkeolojik katmanın önemli ölçüde daha tutarlı bir buluntu grubu oluşturduğunu göstermektedir. Taş teknolojisi ağırlıklı olarak yonga odaklıdır ve yerel limnoquartzit (veya limnik silisit)in yoğun kullanımı ile çift yüzlü aletlerin yerinde üretimi, inceltilmesi ve yeniden şekillendirilmesi ile karakterize edilir. Kazılan arkeolojik

kayitlar.b: Late Neolithic transformation processes
kayitlar.o: Around 2200–1700 BCE, Scandinavia and Central Europe were shaped by significant socio-environmental transformations. Between central Germany and northern Norway, Nordic flint daggers symbolise these changes—across different societies and under varying environmental conditions. For the first time, this book brings together and interprets both Central European and Scandinavian contributions on this subject. It becomes evident that a wave of innovation transformed the world: flint daggers and flint sickles, new agricultural techniques, and changes in domestic architecture all reflect a new habitus. This new way of life emerged during a period of climate change and had an impact across hundreds of kilometres, affecting an entire subcontinent.
kayitlar.bt: Geç Neolitik Dönem dönüşüm süreçleri
kayitlar.ot: MÖ 2200-1700 yılları civarında İskandinavya ve Orta Avrupa, önemli sosyo-çevresel dönüşümlerle şekillenmiştir. Orta Almanya ile kuzey Norveç arasında, İskandinav çakmaktaşı hançerler bu değişimleri farklı toplumlarda ve çeşitli çevresel koşullar altında simgelemektedir. Bu kitap, ilk kez hem Orta Avrupa hem de İskandinavya'dan bu konuya ilişkin katkıları bir araya getirip yorumlamaktadır. Bir yenilik dalgasının dünyayı dönüştürdüğü açıkça görülmektedir: Çakmaktaşından yapılmış hançerler ve oraklar, yeni tarım teknikleri ve konut mimarisindeki değişikliklerin hepsi yeni bir yaşam tarzını yansıtmaktadır. Bu yeni yaşam tarzı, iklim değişikliği döneminde ortaya çıkmış ve yüzlerce kilometre boyunca etki ederek tüm bir yarımadayı etkilemiştir.
kayitlar.a: (2026). Late Neolithic transformation processes. Scales of Transformation. https://doi.org/10.59641/7x6808aj

kayitlar.bt: İstihdamda ayrımcılık yapmama yasaları, üretim atıklarında azalmalara yol açtı

kayitlar.b: Airlines across 10 countries reveal how founding partners leave lasting assets and liabilities
kayitlar.o: New Strategic Management Journal research shows how founding relationships can shape firms long after the original partnership fades. Kunyuan Qiao, Shon R. Hiatt and Wesley D. Sine examine South American airlines founded in 10 countries between 1919 and 1984 and show that founding partners can leave two very different strategic legacies.
kayitlar.bt: 10 ülkedeki havayolu şirketleri, kurucu ortakların nasıl kalıcı varlıklar ve borçlar bıraktığını ortaya koyuyor
kayitlar.ot: Strategic Management Journal'da yayımlanan yeni bir araştırma, kurucu ilişkilerin orijinal ortaklık sona erdikten uzun süre sonra bile şirketleri nasıl şekillendirebileceğini göstermektedir. Kunyuan Qiao, Shon R. Hiatt ve Wesley D. Sine, 1919-1984 yılları arasında 10 ülkede kurulan Güney Amerika havayollarını inceleyerek kurucu ortakların birbirinden çok farklı iki stratejik miras bırakabileceğini ortaya koyuyor.

kayitlar.b: Available space reshapes cooperation and survival in new game theory model
kayitlar.o: A theoretical study expands classic game-theory models of cooperation by allowing payoffs to change with available environmental capacity. Games such as the prisoner's dilemma help researchers explore how cooperation could have evolved in a world of limited resources.
kayitlar.bt: Mevcut alan, yeni oyun teorisi modelinde iş birliğini ve hayatta kalmayı yeniden şekillendiriyor
kayitlar.ot: Teorik bir çalışma, kazançların mevcut çevresel kapasiteye göre değişmesine olanak tanıyarak klasik oyun teorisi iş birliği modellerini genişletmektedir. Tutsağın ikilemi gibi oyunlar, araştırmacıların sınırlı kaynaklara sahip bir dünyada iş birliğinin nasıl gelişmiş olabileceğini araştırmalarına yardımcı olmaktadır.

kayitlar.b: Why punishment doesn't always prevent crime
kayitlar.o: From "three-strikes" laws to longer prison sentences, harsher penalties are imposed in the hope they'll reduce crime. But decades of research show that increasing punishment often does surprisingly little. What if we're missing something crucial? New research from the University of California San Diego suggests one potentially overlooked reason: people's moral motivations for breaking the law in the first place.
kayitlar.bt: Cezalar neden her zaman suçu önlemez?
kayitlar.ot: "Üç suçta hapis" yasalarından daha uzun hapis cezalarına kadar, suç oranlarını düşüreceği umuduyla daha ağır cezalar uygulanmaktadır. Ancak onlarca yıllık araştırmalar, cezaların artırılmasının çoğu zaman şaşırtıcı derecede az etki yarattığını göstermektedir. Ya çok önemli bir şeyi gözden kaçırıyorsak? California Üniversitesi San Diego'dan yapılan yeni bir araştırma, gözden kaçmış olabilecek bir nedene işaret ediyor: İnsanların öncelikle yasaları çiğnemek için sahip oldukları ahlaki motivasyonlar.
kayitlar.a: Why punishment doesn't always prevent crime. (2026, 17 Kasım). Phys.org Arkeoloji. https://phys.org/news/2026-11-doesnt-crime.html

kayitlar.b: Whom do we expect to put others ahead of themselves: Boys or girls? New study has surprising, and unsurprising, answers
kayitlar.o: The holiday season is a time for gatherings with family and friends—as well as for less festive but necessary duties: organizing, preparing for and cleaning up after these gatherings. These are examples of service tasks that, according to previous research, women and girls are expected to perform.
kayitlar.bt: Başkalarını kendilerinden önce koymalarını kimden bekleriz: Erkeklerden mi yoksa kızlardan mı? Yeni bir çalışma şaşırtıcı ve şaşırtıcı olmayan cevaplar içeriyor
kayitlar.ot: Tatil dönemi, aile ve arkadaşlarla bir araya gelmenin yanı sıra daha az keyifli ama gerekli işlerin de yapıldığı bir zamandır: bu buluşmaları organize etmek, hazırlamak ve sonrasında temizlik yapmak. Bunlar, önceki araştırmalara göre kadınlardan ve kız çocuklarından yapmalarının beklendiği hizmet görevlerine örneklerdir.
kayitlar.a: Whom do we expect to put others ahead of themselves: Boys or girls? New study has surprising, and unsurprising, answers. (2026, 17 Kasım). Phys.org Arkeoloji. https://phys.org/news/2026-11-boys-girls-unsurprising.html

kayitlar.b: Study tracks what students learn from online teamwork and fieldwork abroad
kayitlar.o: Can a solution that cuts food waste in Tokyo work in Seoul too? Exploring a familiar problem with peers abroad can help students question what they take for granted at home and see how their knowledge might apply to real-world sustainability challenges. As educators put time and care into designing international courses, what do students take away from the experience, and what stays with them after the course ends?
kayitlar.bt: Çalışma, öğrencilerin çevrim içi ekip çalışmasından ve yurtdışındaki saha çalışmalarından neler öğrendiklerini inceliyor
kayitlar.ot: Tokyo'da gıda israfını azaltan bir çözüm Seul'de de işe yarayabilir mi? Tanıdık bir sorunu yurt dışındaki akranlarıyla birlikte incelemek, öğrencilerin kendi ülkelerinde doğal karşıladıkları şeyleri sorgulamalarına ve bilgilerinin gerçek dünyadaki sürdürülebilirlik sorunlarına nasıl uygulanabileceğini görmelerine yardımcı olabilir. Eğitimciler uluslararası kursları tasarlamak için zaman ve özen harcarken öğrenciler bu deneyimden neler öğreniyor ve kurs sona erdikten sonra neler akıllarında kalıyor?

kayitlar.b: Writing as it should be or as it sounds: Reconstructing how Old English disappeared
kayitlar.o: In the twelfth century, the English-speaking world underwent a major change: Old English gave way to Middle English. In his dissertation, Ph.D. candidate Amos van Baalen uses sermons to reconstruct how this change took place.
kayitlar.bt: Olması gerektiği gibi mi yoksa duyulduğu gibi mi yazmak: Eski İngilizcenin nasıl ortadan kalktığının yeniden yapılandırılması
kayitlar.ot: On ikinci yüzyılda İngilizce konuşan dünyada büyük bir değişim yaşandı: Eski İngilizce yerini Orta İngilizce'ye bıraktı. Doktora adayı Amos van Baalen, tezinde bu değişimin nasıl gerçekleştiğini yeniden oluşturmak için vaazlardan yararlanmaktadır.

kayitlar.b: How restaurants can make sustainable dining choices easier while still making a profit
kayitlar.o: Canadians are eating out less. A 2025 survey found 57% of them are cooking at home more often to save money, while 69% of restaurant operators say customers are dining out less because of affordability. According to Restaurants Canada, 41% of operators are either losing money or breaking even.
kayitlar.bt: Restoranlar kâr elde etmeye devam ederken sürdürülebilir yemek seçeneklerini nasıl daha kolay hâle getirebilir?
kayitlar.ot: Kanadalılar daha az dışarıda yemek yiyor. 2025 yılında yapılan bir ankete göre Kanadalıların %57'si paradan tasarruf etmek için evde daha sık yemek pişiriyor. Öte yandan restoran işletmecilerinin %69'u, müşterilerin maliyetler nedeniyle daha az dışarıda yemek yediğini söylüyor. Restaurants Canada’ya göre işletmecilerin %41’i ya zarar ediyor ya da başa baş çalışıyor.
kayitlar.a: How restaurants can make sustainable dining choices easier while still making a profit. (2026, 17 Kasım). Phys.org Arkeoloji. https://phys.org/news/2026-11-restaurants-sustainable-dining-choices-easier.html

kayitlar.o: ABSTRACT This paper presents the first K‐feldspar post‐infrared infrared (pIRIR) dating of river terrace deposits from the Avon valley, a major northern tributary of the palaeo‐Solent. kayitlar.b: Decoding the Past: An Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning Framework for Sex Attribution in Prehistoric Hand Stencils
kayitlar.y: Karel Becerra; Boris Mederos; Dean Snow; Ramón A. Mollineda
kayitlar.o: Determining the biological sex of the individuals who created Upper Paleolithic hand stencils remains challenging due to the absence of ground truth, morphological differences between contemporary and prehistoric populations, and uncertainties arising from image degradation. Traditional morphometric methods are further constrained by substantial overlap between sexes, limited cross-population generalizability, and subjective feature selection. This study introduces a deep learning framework that explicitly models, propagates, and aggregates uncertainty throughout the analytical pipeline. kayitlar.y: Yu Kai Tan; Thomas F. Duda
kayitlar.o: Many animals attach exogenous objects to their exterior for camouflage or physical armament against predators. The cost and benefit of ‘collecting’ behaviours remain insufficiently studied, but are assumed to be adaptive owing to their persistence despite demonstrated costs. Carrier snails of the family Xenophoridae are the most striking of collectors, capable of cementing diverse environmental objects permanently to their shells. The species-specific object specialization in xenophorids has long been assumed but never explicitly tested. We demonstrate, using submersible-collected snails and their surrounding objects, that a Western Atlantic species, Onustus caribaeus, exhibits a distinct preference to incorporate bivalve shells over abundant lithic clasts. kayitlar.o: This paper examines the zoomorphic reliefs of the Pre-Pottery Neolithic site of Göbekli Tepe (c. 9600–8200 BCE) as expressions of a coherent, pre-literate cosmology. kayitlar.b: Rødhals Man: a life at the end of the Mesolithic world
kayitlar.y: Anders Fischer; John Meadows; Marie Louise Jørkov; Karl-Göran Sjögren; Verner Alexandersen; Anne Birgitte Gotfredsen; T. Douglas Price; Darren Richard Gröcke
kayitlar.o: Found buried within a shell midden on the Sejerø archipelago, the skeleton designated as Rødhals Man is here identified as belonging to the most recent individual in Denmark (who died c . 3800 cal BC) with unadmixed Mesolithic genetic ancestry and a marine-dependent diet. However, through incremental sampling of dentine, the authors show that the diet of this individual was increasingly supplemented, from adolescence onwards, with terrestrial products and argue that these resources were probably farmed. They position Rødhals Man at the end of the Mesolithic world, providing a glimpse into the Neolithic transition at the scale of an individual life.

kayitlar.o: The African “Neolithic” emerged in northeastern Africa during the African Humid Period, 12,500-3500 BCE. kayitlar.y: Chris Clarkson; Gilbert James Price; Amir Kalifi; Giacomo Losi; Carney Matheson; Faisal Al‐Jibreen; Abdullah Alsharekh; Simon James Armitage
kayitlar.o: After the African origin of Homo sapiens , multiple dispersals radiated into Asia, yet the Saharo-Arabian archaeological record remains sparse. In this study, we report on ‘Uruq Aljelibah, a Middle Paleolithic site dated to ~125,000 years ago (marine isotope stage 5e) and located on the shore of Mundafan paleolake, Saudi Arabia. Levallois assemblages, refits, and megafaunal associations indicate in situ tool production and carcass processing. Stone tool residues, use-wear, and biomarkers reveal animal and plant processing, including palms, tubers, trees, and shrubs. Several points exhibit impact damage and poison residues (from Acokanthera schimperi ), indicating use as hafted weapon tips within composite hunting systems. kayitlar.y: Manfred Bucher

Above the PG temperature, the remaining Cu3d-O2p holes are thermally demotted, initiating the strange metal (SM) phase. kayitlar.y: Libby Ann Boydstun
kayitlar.o: Southern Gothic literature arose in the American South from the long-standing tradition of Gothic literature. It combined traditional, Gothic elements with commentary on the tumultuous history and culture of the South. Marked by authors like Cormac McCarthy, Tennessee Williams, William Faulkner, and Truman Capote, the genre is defined by depictions of the grotesque and macabre. But despite these dark elements, hope, grace, and redemption have their place among Southern Gothic stories. They are more obvious in the works of contemporary authors like Pat Conroy and Delia Owens, but are still present in the older works. This paper will examine several works in the stages of Southern Gothic’s development: As I Lay Dying; “A Good Man is Hard to Find;” The Heart is a Lonely Hunter; Other Voices, Other Rooms; Child of God; Prince of Tides; Bastard out of Carolina; and Where the Crawdads Sing. kayitlar.o: The problem of comorbid infections remains at the center of attention in modern rheumatology. The third part of this review presents current data on the frequency and localization of the major infections in patients with rheumatological disorders treated with interleukin-6 inhibitors (IL-6i). Both randomized controlled trials and experience with the use of IL-6 inhibitors, primarily tocilizumab, in real-world clinical practice indicate that these drugs increase the risk of opportunistic and serious bacterial infections to the same extent as other genetically engineered biological drugs. kayitlar.y: David Nothstine
kayitlar.o: This work examines the recurring pattern by which scientific understanding advances through problems, solutions, consequences, and deeper problems. Beginning with Newton’s Third Law as a familiar expression of action and reaction, the discussion extends beyond mechanics to consider a broader architecture of consequence in which one action may generate multiple reactions, branching pathways, feedback, and reorganization within complex physical systems. The manuscript argues that human reasoning developed around local, linear cause-and-effect relationships that were highly effective for survival but can become restrictive when applied to nonlinear, interconnected, and stratified systems. kayitlar.o: Social identity theory provides a rich description of how humans relate to various kinds of social groups, but no substantive account of why human psychology evolved to be so group-minded in the first place. kayitlar.b: Identifying numbers in the archaeological record
kayitlar.y: Karenleigh A. Overmann
kayitlar.o: Numbers are one of the longest-lived cultural systems the world has ever known, but we still do not know how old numbers might be, or where and why they might have first emerged or in what form. Contemporary number systems have implications for examining and interpreting the archaeological record for signs of pre-Historic numeracy. To define what we should be looking for in the archaeological record and how we might recognise numbers in markings on pre-Historic artefacts, current assumptions, evidence, methods, and issues are reviewed, and recommendations are offered for incorporating interdisciplinary data and insights into archaeological investigations and interpretations.

kayitlar.b: Variability in lithic technology during the Neolithic in the western Balkans
kayitlar.y: Ivana Jovanović; Marc Vander Linden
kayitlar.o: The period between 6200–4500 cal BC is a time of significant socio-economic and technological changes in the western Balkans. The spread of farming practices also triggered a series of changes in stone tool production. This paper explores intra- and inter-site variability in Neolithic lithic technology across the region, using both qualitative and quantitative methods. The results show that technology and typology remained relatively consistent, while the management of raw materials reveals distinct regional differences in both the Early and Late Neolithic. Geographical patterns of lithic distribution and access to resources further highlight regional and inter-regional connections, offering insights into community interactions and mobility.

kayitlar.y: Dmytro Haskevych
kayitlar.o: This article examines the sole anthropomorphic representation associated with the sub-Neolithic Buh-Dniester culture (BDC). It is a conical marl artefact with schematic facial features, perforation, and engraved decoration. Comparative analysis in both farming and hunter-gatherer contexts of South-Eastern and Eastern Europe reveals its closest parallels with some Criş-Starčevo column-shaped ceramic figurines and a rare anthropomorphic ceramic loom weight, all dated to the second and early third quarters of the sixth millennium BC. Despite an apparent link to the farming sphere, this isolated stone symbolic object does not represent the worldview of the broader population associated with the BDC. Predlagamo hevristični okvir, v katerem razlikujemo med čisto pareidolijo, pareidolijo z intervencijo in pareidolijo z ustvarjanjem, in upoštevamo stopnjo materialne intervencije ter arheološke dokaze o družbeni stabilizaciji. kayitlar.b: INSIGHTS INTO THE AUTHORSHIP OF PALAEOLITHIC CAVE ART THROUGH GEOMETRIC MORPHOMETRICS ANALYSIS OF PALM PRINTS: THE CASE OF POINTS CAVE (AIGUÈZE, GARD, FRANCE)
kayitlar.y: Vincent Bonhomme; Julien Monney
kayitlar.o: Determining how many individuals produced pre-Historic rock art, and whether they collaborated or worked separately, is crucial for reconstructing social contexts. Geometric morphometrics provides a quantitative approach to authorship. We analysed 59 Upper Palaeolithic red palm prints from four clusters in Points Cave (Aiguèze, Gard, France) to test the number of authors. Palm contours were extracted from 3D cave models. Morphology was quantified using elliptical Fourier analysis. Results show a strong link between palm form and location, distinguishing the Recess from the Gallery. Simulations indicate at least two, probably three, authors overall; clusters 15 and 11 likely reflect single individuals, whereas clusters 12 and 14 remain uncertain. These findings exclude both collective ritual production and long-term cumulative accumulation.

kayitlar.b: CONSTRUCTING CUPULE SCIENCE: ROBERT G. BEDNARIK AND THE METHODOLOGICAL EVOLUTION OF NON-ICONIC ROCK ART STUDIES
kayitlar.y: Chen Yuzhi; Li Man; Tang Huisheng
kayitlar.o: Rock art is the most widespread and abundant form of surviving remains in palaeoart. Among them, fully non-iconic percussion petroglyphs, represented by cupules—due to their extreme morphological simplicity, lack of iconographic content and absence of ethnographic references—have become crucial yet most intractable materials for reconstructing the origins of human cognition and early symbolic behaviour. Traditional research has long relied on stylistics, iconography and ethnographic analogy: methods that are highly subjective, lack falsifiable criteria and are inherently unsuited to non-figurative remains. The subtractive technology of petroglyphs makes direct dating extremely difficult, and taphonomic biases are often misread as patterns of cultural evolution, resulting in the long-term marginalisation of ancient cupule remains within mainstream archaeology. kayitlar.o: Abstract Searching current petabase-scale sequence repositories requires indexes that combine compact storage with high query throughput. kayitlar.y: Josep Maria Vergès Bosch; Míriam Salas-Altès
kayitlar.o: Until recently, Palaeolithic parietal art was scarce in the north-eastern Iberian Peninsula. An assemblage of engravings found within Cova de la Font Major in 2019, and described here, now calls this apparent artistic lacuna into question. Comprising 280 motifs, encompassing 55 zoomorphic figures and a range of non-figurative representations, the Font Major assemblage is positioned as one of the largest Palaeolithic cave art ensembles in the Iberian Mediterranean. Its recent discovery calls for a reconsideration of regional preconceptions, while the attribution of numerous representations to pre-Magdalenian phases establishes the site as a key reference for studying Palaeolithic symbolic expressions.

kayitlar.b: Patch-Based Generalized Neural Texture Upscaling
kayitlar.y: Shin Fujieda; Takahiro Harada
kayitlar.o: We propose a lightweight neural texture upscaling method. A single generalized MLP is trained on a diverse collection of texture patches and integrated into the texture sampling stage, upscaling low-resolution textures on-the-fly at rendering time. Because the model is generalized rather than overfit to specific content, no per-asset training is required - the same model applies to any existing scene without modifying texture data or the asset pipeline. Storing lower-resolution base textures reduces disk footprint, upscaling at sampling time eliminates the need to store high-resolution textures in VRAM, and sharing a single set of model weights across all textures ensures non-divergent GPU execution. We evaluate our method across multiple texture classes, demonstrating consistent improvement over analytic upscaling methods in perceptual quality.

kayitlar.o: A groundbreaking discovery is rewriting the story of human evolution, revealing that an ancient human species once thought to be an evolutionary dead end may have left genetic traces in people alive today. By extracting proteins from 400,000-year-old Homo erectus teeth discovered in China, scientists uncovered evidence suggesting that these early humans interbred with Denisovans, another mysterious ancient human group. kayitlar.o: Music is central to what makes us human. Yet, despite decades of research across cognitive science, archaeology, and evolutionary biology, there is no consensus on when human musicality first emerged. kayitlar.b: Un caso de atresia del conducto auditivo externo del III milenio a.C. procedente de la Sima del Ángel (Lucena, Córdoba)
kayitlar.y: Francisco Javier Parra Bermúdez; José Hidalgo
kayitlar.o: El objetivo de este trabajo es exponer un nuevo caso de atresia del conducto auditivo externo y poner al día el escaso registro paleopatológico. El temporal derecho CA-P5-195, procedente de la Sima del Ángel (Lucena, Córdoba), se caracteriza por carecer del conducto auditivo externo debido a la ausencia de la porción timpánica. Este tipo de malformación congénita es raro y los ejemplares paleopatológicos son extremadamente infrecuentes, especialmente aquellos procedentes de contextos europeos anteriores a la Edad Media. El abundante material antropológico exhumado en la Sima del Ángel data mayoritariamente del Calcolítico (ca. 3000–2500 cal BC). El temporal CA-P5-195 puede ser uno de los casos más antiguos de atresia auditiva que se conocen, al mismo tiempo queuno de los escasos ejemplos de sordera conductiva de la Prehistoria.
kayitlar.a: Bermúdez, F. J. P., & Hidalgo, J. (2026). Un caso de atresia del conducto auditivo externo del III milenio a.C. procedente de la Sima del Ángel (Lucena, Córdoba). Revista Paleopatologia. https://doi.org/10.65108/revista/12-26/articulo-1/

kayitlar.o: The bone industry of the Middle Paleolithic was organized like a stone industry and consisted of two stages: splitting large bones into flakes and making tools from the flakes. In the collections from the sites in the Donbas, the Northeastern Azov region, and the Lower Don, the few bone tools were associated with butchering the carcasses of bison and horses. Currently, the knowledge regarding the risk of AML associated with general environmental factors is limited. In a systematic review, we aimed to investigate the existing evidence. A literature search in three databases was initially conducted on May 24, 2024, and updated throughout the study period with a finale search on November 26, 2025. Studies were screened by title and abstract ( n = 6685) and by full-text reading ( n = 133). kayitlar.o: The southern Levant extends between the hyperarid Sahara–Arabia Desert belt in the south and the temperate Mediterranean climate zone in the north, making the regional hydroclimate extremely sensitive to even small perturbations of global climate. kayitlar.y: Grzegorz Michalec
kayitlar.w: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
kayitlar.o: BP 1258 is a prehistoric archaeological site located in the Bayuda Desert, northern Sudan. The site is situated near an outcrop of Nubian Sandstone and preserves evidence of prehistoric lithic workshop. The lithic assemblage is predominantly associated with the Large Flake Acheulean of the Early Stone Age (ESA), while the presence of technologically distinct artefacts indicates a later occupation during the Middle Stone Age (MSA). The archaeological record has been affected by post-depositional processes, particularly aeolian deflation and possible sediment redeposition, resulting in a complex surface assemblage representing multiple episodes of human activity. This 3D model documents the site’s present-day topography and archaeological landscape, providing a spatial reference for research into lithic technology, human occupation and site formation processes in the Eastern Sahara.
